alert_text: ERROR StripeChargeProcessor - Request timed out after 30000ms while creating charge. orderId=ORD-918273
root_cause: Outbound firewall rule update blocked traffic from payments-api pods to Stripe API endpoints.
resolution_steps: Verified timeout spikes in application metrics
post_mortem_summary: Payment processing failed for approximately 18% of checkout attempts. Change management procedures were updated to require automated connectivity validation after firewall modifications.

alert_text: WARN JWTValidator - Token signature verification failed for issuer=[https://auth.internal
root_cause: JWT](https://auth.internal%22,%22root_cause%22:%22JWT) signing key rotation completed in auth-service but api-gateway cache still contained the previous public key.
resolution_steps: Compared active and cached signing keys
post_mortem_summary: Users experienced intermittent login failures immediately after key rotation. A synchronized key propagation workflow was implemented to prevent cache inconsistency.

alert_text: ERROR CatalogIndexer - java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
root_cause: Bulk product import generated oversized indexing batches that exceeded configured JVM heap limits.
post_mortem_summary: Product updates stopped propagating to the storefront during the incident. Batch-size validation and memory monitoring thresholds were added.

alert_text: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for superuser connections
root_cause: Connection pool leak in inventory synchronization worker exhausted PostgreSQL connection limits.
post_mortem_summary: Inventory lookups failed and checkout stock validation degraded. Automated alerts for connection pool anomalies were introduced.

alert_text: ERROR EmailDispatcher - RabbitMQ consumer lag exceeded threshold. queueDepth=128945
root_cause: SMTP provider rate limits caused message retries to accumulate faster than consumers could process them.
post_mortem_summary: Order confirmation emails were delayed but not lost. Retry policies were adjusted to better handle external provider throttling.

alert_text: 502 Bad Gateway - upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers
root_cause: Kubernetes readiness probe misconfiguration routed traffic to uninitialized backend pods.
post_mortem_summary: Customers experienced elevated API errors during deployment. Deployment validation now includes readiness probe verification.

alert_text: ERROR ElasticsearchClient - shard allocation failed due to disk watermark exceeded
root_cause: Search cluster node storage reached high watermark, preventing shard allocation.
post_mortem_summary: Search performance degraded and some queries returned incomplete results. Capacity planning thresholds were revised.

alert_text: ERROR FeatureLoader - Redis connection refused at redis://feature-store:6379
root_cause: Feature store Redis cluster failed after an unsuccessful node upgrade.
post_mortem_summary: Personalized recommendations were unavailable during the outage. Upgrade procedures now require staged validation in production.

alert_text: ERROR FraudCheckClient - HTTP 429 Too Many Requests from fraud-scoring provider
root_cause: Traffic surge exceeded contracted API rate limits for external fraud detection service.
post_mortem_summary: Some payment authorizations experienced delays. The platform added adaptive throttling and fallback decision logic.

alert_text: ERROR UserSessionRepository - Deadlock detected while updating session records
root_cause: Recent schema migration introduced an index causing lock contention on session updates.
post_mortem_summary: Session creation latency increased significantly during peak traffic. Database migration reviews were expanded to include lock analysis.

alert_text: ERROR ReplicaMonitor - replication lag exceeded 1800 seconds
root_cause: Long-running reporting query saturated I/O on the primary database node.
resolution_steps: Moved report processing to dedicated replica
post_mortem_summary: Inventory data became stale across dependent services. Resource isolation was implemented for analytical workloads.

alert_text: ERROR PushNotificationSender - Invalid APNS certificate detected
root_cause: Expired Apple Push Notification certificate was not renewed before expiration.
post_mortem_summary: Mobile push notifications failed for affected users. Certificate expiration monitoring was added to operational dashboards.

alert_text: ERROR RateLimiter - Redis timeout while evaluating request quotas
root_cause: Redis cluster CPU saturation increased latency beyond gateway timeout thresholds.
post_mortem_summary: Request processing latency increased across public APIs. Traffic distribution logic was improved to reduce hot key pressure.

alert_text: WARN QueryExecutor - Search latency exceeded SLA. p95=4100ms
root_cause: New synonym expansion rules generated excessively complex Elasticsearch queries.
post_mortem_summary: Customers experienced slow product searches. Search relevance updates now undergo performance benchmarking before deployment.

alert_text: ERROR ProductSyncJob - Foreign key constraint violation on category mapping
root_cause: Partial category import completed before dependent product records were synchronized.
post_mortem_summary: Several products disappeared from category listings temporarily. Import sequencing controls were strengthened.

alert_text: ERROR ModelInferenceService - feature vector dimension mismatch expected=512 actual=508
root_cause: Feature engineering deployment introduced schema changes without updating production model metadata.
post_mortem_summary: Recommendation quality degraded and some requests failed. Model deployment pipelines now enforce feature schema validation.

alert_text: ERROR DatabaseTransactionManager - transaction rollback due to serialization failure
root_cause: Concurrent order updates exceeded database transaction isolation handling capacity during flash sale traffic.
post_mortem_summary: Checkout failures increased during peak demand. Transaction retry mechanisms reduced user-facing impact in future events.

alert_text: ERROR LDAPConnector - unable to establish TLS handshake with identity provider
root_cause: Intermediate CA certificate was missing from the trust store after container image update.
post_mortem_summary: Enterprise users could not authenticate through federated login. Trust store validation was added to image build checks.

alert_text: ERROR WALArchiver - archive command failed with exit code 1
root_cause: Backup storage bucket permissions were removed during infrastructure policy update.
post_mortem_summary: Database recovery point objectives were temporarily at risk. Infrastructure permission changes now require automated backup validation.

alert_text: ERROR CircuitBreaker - open state triggered for upstream service product-catalog
root_cause: Product-catalog deployment introduced N+1 database query pattern causing request timeouts.
post_mortem_summary: Product browsing and checkout flows experienced widespread degradation. Performance regression testing was expanded to detect query inefficiencies before release.
